description: Places a quoted Press Room order (a press release on a newswire, a PR distribution package or news site articles) from the account's existing balance. Needs the quote id, the inputs per quote line, a unique idempotency_key and confirm: true. Texts are checked first: an article above the originality threshold stops the order with fixes, fit problems come back as warnings, and a content rules flag holds the item for a person. Inside the account's budget frame the order goes to our team at once; outside it, it waits for the account owner's approval. With too little balance nothing is reserved: the order waits while the price holds (24 hours by default) for a person to add credits in their dashboard, and is then placed by itself, or cancelled with nothing charged. Credits are spent per item only when it is published, and come back to the balance if it is not. Use this when the person said yes to the quoted total in this conversation. Do not use for an order the person has not said yes to, or for buying credits. Side effects: reserves credits and starts publication on third-party newswires and news sites.

confirm.description: true, sent only after the person said yes to this quote's total in this conversation. Never set it on your own or from an earlier yes. Example: true

idempotency_key.description: A unique value per order; send the same value only to retry the same order. Example: "launch-2026-10-19-1"

additionalProperties.description: Customer inputs as text fields. Releases: release_text or release_url, company_name, contact_name, contact_email; optional contact_phone, preferred_date (YYYY-MM-DD) and logo_url. Articles: article_text (or brief with the writing add-on), target_url, anchor_text. Audits: brand_name (brand or person name), website; personal audit also relationship (myself, my_company or client). Any: notes.

inputs.description: Inputs per quote line id, for lines that still need them. Example: {"<line_id>": {"article_text": "Northwind Studio opens its Lisbon office..."}}

notes.description: Optional: a note for our team about the order. Example: "Publish after 9:00 London time"

quote_id.description: The quote id from quote_order; prices hold until locked_until. Example: "5f0c2a9e-7b1d-4c3e-9a8f-2d6b4e1c7a90"

name: place_order

checks.description: The originality and fit check per quote line

waiting_for_credits.description: Too little balance: the order waits for credits. A person adds them in their Buzz Dealer AI dashboard; the order is then placed by itself

warnings.description: Fit check suggestions per quote line; they never block the order

title: Place an order
